_comment: SCHEMA REFERENCE + starting template for _shared/hosts.json. Copy to hosts.json and fill in. This is the ONLY place host-specific facts (addresses, users, key paths, hardware, platform quirks) belong — skill SKILL.md prose and script defaults must stay host-agnostic and speak in ROLES.

_roles_vocabulary.gpu-test: Primary GPU / streaming test host. DEFAULT target of every host-taking verb. Judge stream quality here.
_roles_vocabulary.aux-infra: Sanctioned infrastructure host: network-impairment shaping (netem/IFB) and the headless browser peer. May also host the container build/test runner. Never the box you judge Quasar's own quality on unless it is also gpu-test.
_roles_vocabulary.deploy-only: Production/staging deployment target. Read-only verbs only — skills refuse destructive or experiment verbs against it, and gate merely-mutating ones behind an explicitly named host. Enforced by q_guard_mutating in _shared/lib.sh, which every skill script calls; each skill's scripts/validate asserts it against _shared/fixtures/hosts.three-role.json. A new write verb that skips the guard is the bug this sentence used to describe.
_roles_vocabulary._note: A role maps to exactly one host name. A host may hold several roles. Roles a deployment does not have are simply absent; skills that need a missing role say so instead of guessing. A single-box install can point every role at the same host.

_local_loopback_pattern: A stack host that also needs to drive ITSELF unattended (e.g. a cron job — scripts/dx/nightly_budget.sh) hits a real gap: qses/bench_run.sh always ssh out to whatever --stack names, even when that IS the caller's own machine — there is no 'skip the hop, we're already here' path. Fix (devbox, 2026-08-19): add a hosts{} entry with ssh_host 127.0.0.1, keyed by a DEDICATED keypair (e.g. ~/.ssh/id_ed25519_loopback) added to that box's own authorized_keys — never reuse an interactive/1Password-backed key for this. DO NOT name this entry 'local': common.sh's DX_HOST=local sentinel means something else entirely ('skip remote resolution, this is the ephemeral docker-compose.local.yml dev stack on its own DX_CP_PORT') and bench_run.sh's own admin-API calls (host_curl) fall back to that port whenever DX_HOST=local — a same-named hosts.json entry does NOT override that, so every admin API call silently targets the wrong stack while qses/session launch still (confusingly) works, because qses resolves purely from hosts.json and never consults DX_HOST at all. Use a distinct, real host name instead (e.g. 'devbox-self') so bench_run.sh's normal dx_resolve_remote -> DX_REMOTE_API path takes over correctly. See docs/testing-bench-mode.md 'A nightly budget run'.

my-gpu-box._comment: Connect EITHER by ssh_alias (a ~/.ssh/config entry that works headlessly) OR by ssh_host + ssh_user + ssh_key. If ssh_key is given, lib.sh adds IdentityAgent=none / IdentitiesOnly=yes so an interactive agent (1Password etc.) never blocks a headless run.
notes: Free-form operational facts about THIS box — driver quirks, disk layout, reboot-volatile paths, working-directory rules. Skills surface these instead of hardcoding gear specifics in their prose.

_field_reference.ssh_alias: string — ~/.ssh/config host alias. Mutually exclusive with ssh_host/ssh_user/ssh_key.
_field_reference.ssh_key: string — path to a private key; '~' is expanded. Presence switches lib.sh to agent-less key auth.
_field_reference.ip: string — address used when a peer must name this host on the wire (netem src-ip filters, route lookups).
_field_reference.dir: string — the Quasar checkout / working directory on that host. REQUIRED.
_field_reference.api: string — control-plane API base URL as seen FROM that host (usually localhost).
_field_reference.api_external: string — control-plane API base URL as seen from other hosts.
_field_reference.agent_api: string — plain-HTTP agent/health listener (distinct from the HTTPS browser listener in `api`).
_field_reference.gpu: one of nvidia | amd | intel | none. Drives GPU-gated image assertions. REQUIRED.
_field_reference.platform: string — free-form OS/appliance label (linux, unraid, ...). Skills may cite it when a note is platform-specific.
_field_reference.runtime_image: string — node-agent runtime image tag for this host.
_field_reference.bench_app: string — default benchmark app name the live-session harness launches here.
_field_reference.compose_files: array of repo-relative paths — the docker compose file(s) this host's stack is composed from: always deploy/docker-compose.yml, plus the overlays this host needs (docker-compose.nvidia.yml on a CUDA box, overlays/docker-compose.console.yml for local display). Defaults to [deploy/docker-compose.yml].
_field_reference.compose_files_multiagent: array — optional overlay set for the multi-agent (N>1) stack. Absent means the host does not run one.
_field_reference.redeploy_label: string — the HARDWARE PROFILE deploy/redeploy.sh expects as its first argument: `va` (AMD/Intel) or `nvidia`. Not a host name — the script has no per-box branch.
_field_reference.notes: array of strings — operator knowledge about this host. Skills print these rather than embedding gear specifics in shipped prose.

harness._comment: Non-admin user the live-session harness registers/logs in as. Use a throwaway credential; it is created on the target stack.

netem._comment: Named impairment levels, passed verbatim to `tc ... netem`. Add or rename freely; skills accept a level name or a literal args string.
